name: IHI Corporation
summary: IHI Corporation designs and builds engineering solutions in Japan, North America, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Resources, Energy and Environment; Social Infrastructure; Industrial Systems and General-Purpose Machinery; and Aero Engine, Space and Defense.
